mcp_tools.name: single_living_trip_itinerary
mcp_tools.title: Single living trip itinerary
mcp_tools.description: Submits a single living trip itinerary record (trip header, entry and transit constraint declarations, itinerary entries in idea/held/booked states with declared totals, skeleton and ordering, declared totals, conflicts, pre-departure read-through, red lines) and returns a deterministic SINGLE_LIVING_TRIP_ITINERARY_READY / SINGLE_LIVING_TRIP_ITINERARY_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed date-ordering, leg-connection and booked-total summation checks over the declared entries, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared itinerary record only; it searches nothing, prices nothing live and books nothing.

inputSchema.description: The single living trip itinerary manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
